raw:
Medical VQA with images and text is multimodal. The retrieval component fetches text medical facts, but the overall system is image+text. Rule E9: "multimodal-only RAG (text-only RAG is in scope)." This paper's RAG sits within a multimodal VQA system, so it falls under E9. The retrieval is of text facts from external sources, though, and the generator conditions on them, so there's some ambiguity. Still, the system is clearly multimodal (image features and text), so I lean toward E9.

{"decision": "EXCLUDE", "code": "E9", "reason": "Medical visual question answering with image-text fusion; multimodal RAG, not text-only."}
